buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (PQC)/ ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA The followings are the Eligibility criteria for this Non-divisible service Contract. The bidder may visi t the proposed work site to get well acquaint about the site work before filling the rate/submit the tender. 1. PAST PERFORMANCE AND PROJECT / PAST EXPERIENCE etc. CRITERIA:

Bidder shall have successfully completed similar works during last 7 (Seven) years ending on b id opening date as per any one of following: 1. Experience of having successfully completed similar works during last 7 years ending last d ay of month previous to the one in which applications are invited should be either of the followi ng: Three similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to 40% of the estimated cost (36.16 Lakh) OR Two similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to 50% of the estimated c ost (45.20 Lakh) OR One similar completed work costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of the estimated c ost (72.33 Lakh) The “Similar Work” means“Experience in execution of “Transportation work of Minerals / Tailings/ Sand/ Aggregates/ Fly Ash/ Other Minerals”. (Work Order Copy & Complet ion Certificate / Invoice copy should be attached as supporting document) 2. FINANCIAL STANDING: Average annual financial turnover during the last three financial years should be at least 30% of the yearly estimated Cost (27.13 Lakhs). 3. DEBARMENT FROM TENDERING: The contractor who has not successfully completed previous tenders at UCIL will be debarred fro m participation in this tender. 4. GEOGRAPHIC PRESENCE: Office registration certificate: Registered Office within the geographical limits of Jharkhand st ate where the services need to be provided. Documentary evidence must be provided in the fo rm of Municipality trade license or other such documents as per the following which satisfies a s a proof of having the office establishment. I. Trade License issued by the local authority in the name of the Firm or II. Local Employee Exchange registration for contractor as per Govt. of Jharkhand. Or III. GSTIN registration or IV. Udyam Certificate. Without submission of the above documents for Office address in the State of Jharkhand, then the Bidder will be disqualified in Techno Commercial bid.

5. EPF registration copy, ESIC, GSTIN copy & Make in India Compliance must be submitted alon g with the bid. 6. Any bid not complying PQC requirements shall be summarily rejected. 7. EMD exemption only to relevant MSME/MSE. 8. Prior Turnover and Experience exemption for relevant Startups as per government guideline s. 9. The tender documents shall be issued free of cost to company/units registered with MSME/Na tional Small Industries Corporation/Director of Industries of State, Cottage Industries approved by the State Authority or any other entity as may be specified by Govt. guidelines from time to time, after ensuring that the approval pertains to the class of item/works for which tender is flo ated. II. Scope of work: The scope of this tender will be generally as per specification schedule of quantities and general / special conditions of contract and as directed by Engineer in cha rge, on behalf of Corporation. However, the scope of work covered complete in all respect under this contract are as follows: 1. Loading of Uranium ore by mechanical means like wheel Loader from UCIL, Bagjata Mine s and transportation of the same up to Mill of UCIL, Jaduguda in covered and well maintaine d Tippers/Dumper and dumping the same at ground hopper of UCIL Mill, Jaduguda including weighment at Jaduguda weigh bridge as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. 2. Loading of Mill Tailing/River Sand/Aggregate by mechanical means such as wheel loader/ JCB Loader from UCIL Jaduguda tailing paddock, weighment of Tailing/River Sand/Aggregat e to be done at Jaduguda weighbridge and transportation of the same up to UCIL, Bagjata S towing yard in covered and well maintained Tippers/Dumpers, inclusive of all handling, tool s etc. complete, as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. 3. Bagjata Mines is located 32 km East of Jaduguda Mines and 11 km East of Mosaboni Mine s in the Singhbhum East district of Jharkhand State. 4. For quality check of ROM, all Tippers carrying ore have to pass through the BOA (Bulk Or e Analyzer)/ARCH Room before it is being dispatched to Jaduguda. 5. Schedule of work mentioned in BOQ to be carried out as per direction of Engineer-in-char ge. 6. The heavy vehicles required for the work on hire basis should not be manufactured earli er than the year 2016. 7. Spillage etc during transportation of ore and tailing – While transporting, all loaded dump ers/Hyva etc must be covered with Tarpaulin as per following specification. (a)Tarpaulin made of canvas/high-density polyethine cloth stitched and having eyelets fitt ed on all borders. The size of the tarpaulin shall be larger than the dump box so as to cover the top of the dump box completely.

(b)The tarpaulin is to be fixed on all side hooks of the dumper in such a way that at least it will be 200mm below from the rim of the dump box. (C)Tarpaulin must be changed as and when insisted by the Engineer in charge, to avoid the dust and spillage in the public surrounding area/villages/on road. 8. Dumping of ore and tailing outside the company area: If dumping of ore or tailing becomes unavoidable due to repair and maintenance or any oth er reasons like overturning or any other accidental causes the Bidder shall clear the dumpe d ore or tailing within 48 hours of such incident and failing to above, the UCIL shall take ste ps to clear the ore or tailing and the cost incurred shall be deducted from the running bill of the Bidder. The cost involve to clear the ore or tailing shall be intimated to the Bidder within 48 hours before carrying out the work and if Bidder does not reply immediately after getting the intimation it will be deemed that Bidder has no objection to the estimated cost. 9. PPE’s i.e. Safety Shoe, Uniform, Safety Jacket, Nose mask, Ear plug, Safety goggles, Safet y helmet to be provided by the contractor. Note:-Contractors are advised to see the area get acquainted with the actual fea tures of the land where work is to be executed and get other related information before quoting their rates for carrying out the work successfully. Scope of Bidder: 1) The contractor shall deploy adequate number of Dumpers everyday to achieve the Ore Transport ation target per day. Weekly rest and leave will be applicable as per respective act. 2) The Bidder shall provide 3 national Holidays for all workmen. . 2.
